items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: I go to Uncle, Mr. Peterson, see. So, I go out there, and he said to me, yeah. You know, he says, you were, I used to go to Raymond's boy, Ray Paducah, three of us, see. That's how I went on Raymond. Mm-hmm. Take lessons out there, see.

ctx.x: Billy was with WWL singing, see, and he had another job at night in another place. He did, Billy. So, I was playing with Pinky, see. See, Pinky and I used to double date, see, with Bertha, you know. With Bertha, you know. With no challenge, you know. Bertha's too, see. So, that's how I got involved with the music. And, in those days, New Orleans, you know, they had a lot of house parties, you know. I'd brought pianos, you know. Uh-huh. Some homebrew, you know, bring the band in, that's it, see. So, that's how I…
Harry Hopkins, I don't remember him.
